sentences.text: Sima Ghatak vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 19

Aloke
Ct. No. 30
 Crr 1088 of 2019
 Sima Ghatak
 vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Ors.
 Mr. Milon Mukherjee, ld. Sr. Adv.
 Mr. Sujan Chatterjee
 Mr. Suman Banerjee
 ... for the petitioner
 Ms. Zareen N. Khan
 Ms. Sreeparna Das
 ... for the State
 Mr. Monish Sen
 Ms. Oisani Mukherjee
 ... for the opposite parties

Heard the learned senior counsel appearing for the
 petitioner who has brought to the notice of this Court to a letter
 dated 08.02.2019 submitted by the Deputy Sp, Bankura Zone,
 Cid, West Bengal, before the Court of the learned Additional
 Chief Judicial Magistrate, Durgapur, in connection with the
 present case.

At a later stage, the learned Additional Chief Judicial  Magistrate, Durgapur also took the said report/letter on record  with the observations that the said Deputy SP, Bankura Zone,
 CID, West Bengal had not investigated any case related to the  present incident.

In the meantime, on the basis of that, the learned Sima Ghatak vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors on 19 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/10277903/
1  Magistrate allowed the 'Naraji' Petition and directed further  investigation.

entities.text: Sima Ghatak vs The State Of West Bengal & Ors
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Charge-sheet was filed against accused persons for the  offence punishable under Section 498A/34 of the Indian Penal  Code only.

2  By an order dated 21.08.2018, this Hon'ble Court had directed the D.S.P., C.I.D., Bankura, to submit a report as to the status of the case and accordingly by the report dated 08.02.2019 it has been submitted by the Deputy SP, Bankura Zone, CID, West Bengal, that he personally enquired the petition and forwarded the enquiry report to the Additional Director General of Police,
CID, West Bengal.
And that he did not investigate the case.
It appears that the said enquiry was conducted on the direction of SS (West), CID, West Bengal on the petition of Smt. Sima Ghatak, mother/grandmother of the victims/complainant in this case.
As such, the enquiry report and other connected documents/materials are necessary for the proper adjudication of the present revision.

Accordingly, the learned Public Prosecutor is to appear in this case and take necessary steps for production of all the materials related to the present case, presently with the CID, West Bengal, on the next date of hearing.
Let the matter appear for hearing in the monthly list of October, 2023.

(Shampa Dutt (Paul), J.)
